✨ Smooth Logo Animation

Spring entrance + blur-to-clear + continuous breathing

0.4s — Materialising
blur → clear + spring scale 0.85 → 1.0
1.0s — Logo + Ripples
text visible + rings expanding
1.8s — Cross-fade
logo dissolving → home appearing
What changed:
  • Spring entrance — logo scales from 0.85→1.0 with a spring curve (response: 0.8, damping: 0.7) instead of a flat easeOut. Gives a subtle organic overshoot.
  • Blur-to-clear — logo starts with 6pt blur that clears as it materialises. Adds depth to the "becoming" feel.
  • Continuous breathing — after the entrance settles, the logo gently pulses 0.98↔1.02 on a 2.4s loop. Living, not static.
  • Text drift-up — "TapLog" rises 8pt as it fades in, delayed to 0.5s (was 0.35s). More stagger, more calm.
  • Slower cross-fade — 1.0s hold + 0.8s dissolve (was 0.8s + 0.6s). Spring curve instead of easeInOut. Less rush.
  • Ripple timing — 3.5s expansion per ring, 1.2s stagger (was 3.0s / 1.0s). More room to breathe.
